title: Module 4 Vocabulary Check
intro: Answer each item. Feedback comes right away. Items you miss come back for a retry round.

o: How many standard deviations a score is from the mean, and in which direction
items.why: z = (X minus mean) divided by SD. The sign gives the direction.

items.why: The score equals the mean, so the deviation is zero.

items.q: The mean of a complete set of z scores is
items.why: Standardizing centers the distribution at zero. The SD of z scores is 1.

items.q: In a normal distribution, about what proportion of scores fall within one standard deviation of the mean?
items.why: The 68, 95, 99.7 pattern describes one, two, and three standard deviations.

items.q: The proportion of a normal distribution above z = 0 is
items.why: The normal curve is symmetric, so half the area lies on each side of the mean.

o: Beyond a z score, in the smaller part of the distribution
items.why: For positive z the tail is the upper area beyond z. Use symmetry for negative z.
